title: Randomized Logspace Is Contained in Polynomial Time
statement: Every language decidable by a randomized Turing machine using logarithmic space, halting on every input within some finite input-dependent number of steps, with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members and no accepting branch on nonmembers, is decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time.
